title: Rajdan, Indian Takeaway, Timperley
address: 401 Stockport Rd, Timperley, Altrincham WA15 7UR, United Kingdom

user_reviews.Name: Linda Cotterell
user_reviews.Description: I had a prawn rogan Josh but the prawns were no more than very tiny shrimps. I should have paid more for proper prawns
user_reviews.text_original: I had a prawn rogan Josh but the prawns were no more than very tiny shrimps. I should have paid more for proper prawns

user_reviews.Name: Jenny Meyah
user_reviews.Description: Worth the wait! I had the chicken tikka balti which was delicious. Slightly on the salty side but nothing too different than most curry places. Card payment can be taken on orders over £20. Parking - I managed to get a spot in front but in busier time this may be difficult.

user_reviews.Name: Paul Lawson
user_reviews.Description:
Used this indian for years its the best indian and staff are very good, But the garlic rice let the first meal in years down .I didn't eat the rice ,it was just like cheep long grain rice ..what happened to my favourite indin..let me down with the rice.
If they new it wasn't proper garlic rice made with basmati.  Just tell me next time .I would have not brought that rice..
Still the best indian  by far
No more cheep rice 😢

user_reviews.Name: Ciarán
user_reviews.Description:
Since our local Indian closed down in March 2014 we have been trying to find a new Indian which has the same top quality food and service.
Well we have found it with, Rajdan.
This takeaway always delivers the top quality food! Been back several times and fair to say we have found are new local Indian!

I personally would definitely recommend to everyone!

user_reviews.Name: JohnnyDM
user_reviews.Description: Expected a lot better from other reviews and how busy it always looked but it wasnt the best. It was 20 mins later than they said, forgot part of my order so I had to go back and the food wasn't on the top level I'd expect from the prices they charge. The acid test for me is how a takeaway does a samosa. These were  clearly frozen which is always a bad sign. Taste India a few doors down is a similar price but miles better, all of their samosas etc are cooked fresh and I'd give that place 5/5 so shows you the difference.

user_reviews.Name: Doug Lochery
user_reviews.Description:
Skilled chefs, extensive menu selection, friendly service and exceedingly tasty food all add up to a place you need to know. Yes  it's expensive for a takeaway but you will get restaurant level food and large, tasty portions from a team who know exactly what they're doing.

Best Indian takeaway in Timperly and well worth the trip out to......and I say that as someone who can't stomach Indian food. If you are a fan of this style of food, don't miss this place.
